title: M3k fringe guard for M10_HGB (prospective test Weeks 8-10); M4 recalibration closed without registration
author: Claude (for Constantin)

timing.promised: Specs registered before Week 8 outcomes exist (error register v1, section 5).
timing.actual: Registered after the Week 8 Thursday game (CAR at GB, kickoff 2026-10-30T00:15Z) and before every other Week 8 game (Sunday 1 Nov).
timing.handling: All Week 8 rows of CAR and GB players are excluded from the test (49 of 681 Week 8 M10 rows). No Week 8 outcome was read: the loaders drop every 2026 row with week >= 8 before any processing, and test T2 proves that rewriting those rows leaves every output byte-identical.

status: SHADOW. Computed and reported, never used in SIM-FIE, lineup advice or the app. Adoption only by explicit approval of the owner after the verdict.
what_was_looked_at_before_registration: M10_HGB out-of-sample history 2022-25 (season lock), all weeks: flag biases, ratios by projection band, calibration slopes by week band.

2025 check (fit 2022-24): looked at twice. First for the two forms in the error register's wording (M3-shrink, M4-ab), which failed; then once for the revised forms (M3k, M4-slope). This is one revision after one failure, disclosed here; it weakens the 2025 check as independent evidence.
2026 Weeks 4-7 (CONTAMINATED: M3 and M4 were found on these weeks), reported descriptively only.
Week 8 M10 forecasts (pre-game file captured 29 Oct 10:21 UTC) to produce the frozen Week 8 arm forecasts. No Week 8 outcome.

arm.name: R-M3k

flags.order: a row takes the first flag that applies: FG1, then FG2, then FG3
flags.FG1: week >= 4 and at most 1 game this season with an offensive snap (nflverse snap counts, weeks before the target week)
flags.FG2: rookie (nflverse rookie_season, fallback draft_year) and mean offensive snap share this season < 40 % (no games = 0 %)
flags.FG3: >= 2 games this season and the last game's offensive snap share is at least 15 percentage points below the mean of the up-to-3 games before it

arm.adjustment: flagged: pred' = k[pos, flag] x pred; unflagged: unchanged
arm.k: sum(actual PPR) / sum(M10 PPR) over played history rows (2022-25, weeks >= 4) of that position and flag; cells with < 100 rows pool all positions for that flag; clipped to [0.3, 1.0]. Frozen in c3_m3k_frozen_v1.json, never refitted during the test.
arm.interaction_with_availability: M10 means and the k factors are both conditional on playing (history rows are played rows), so M3k does not double-count the F1 availability discount in SIM-FIE.

evaluation.universe: M10_HGB forecast rows with a stat line (played), QB/RB/WR/TE; Week 8 CAR and GB rows excluded
evaluation.comparison: R-M3k vs raw M10_HGB, pooled over Weeks 8-10, per position
evaluation.pass_rule: all three: (1) PPR MSE lower at >= 3 of 4 positions; (2) PPR MAE not higher by more than 0.02 at any position; (3) mean within-week Spearman (players with either projection >= 5 PPR, week-position cells with >= 8 players) not lower by more than 0.02 at any position
evaluation.reported_not_in_rule: results by flag type, paired bootstrap 90 % interval of the MSE difference (2,000 draws, seed 20261030), week-level rule results, Thursday Sleeper on the same rows where joinable
evaluation.procedure: Week 8: frozen file c3_m3k_week8_forecasts_v1.csv. Weeks 9 and 10: c3_week.py with the frozen k file (features from earlier weeks only). Verdict: c3_grade_run.py after the Week 10 outcomes.
evaluation.prior: About one in three. 2025 (fit 2022-24), Weeks 4-17: passes all three conditions (MSE lower at 4 of 4). 2025 Weeks 8-10 only: MSE lower at 2 of 4 and Spearman guard missed at RB and TE by 0.001-0.002. 2026 Weeks 4-7 (contaminated): MSE lower at 1 of 4; flagged rows over-corrected (bias -0.60 to +0.60).

multiplicity: One arm. It runs alongside 15 other challengers; read its verdict together with theirs.

M4.finding: Real in history, but a mid-season pattern rather than an early-2026 one: 2022-25 slope by week band QB 0.78/1.04/1.18/1.16/0.98, RB 0.99/1.10/1.12/1.05/1.00, TE 0.79/1.16/1.19/1.08/1.07, WR 0.95/1.01/1.04/1.06/1.04 (Weeks 1-3/4-7/8-10/11-13/14-18). At QB it is the fringe effect: slope 1.14 drops to 0.92 without flagged rows.
M4.why_closed: Neither form improves squared error out of sample. M4-ab (a + b x M10, register wording) on 2025: MSE worse at 3 of 4 positions; its intercept carries the history level into seasons with a different level. M4-slope (level-preserving) on 2025 Weeks 4-17 moves MSE by -0.29 to +0.11 pts2 against MSEs of 27-73; in Weeks 8-10 TE -0.82 but QB +0.42; on 2026 Weeks 4-7 (contaminated) TE +0.20. With true slopes of 1.1-1.2, even a perfect stretch recovers (b-1)2 x the projection variance: about 0.6-0.8 % of MSE at QB/RB/WR and about 1.5 % at TE.
M4.what_remains: Spread matters for win probabilities, not point accuracy; the simulator's residual distributions carry it. Revisit only inside the M11 rebuild.

closed_without_registration.M3-shrink: Register wording (shrink toward a position base rate) failed the 2025 check: it pulls low projections up although FG1 players score about 0.5-0.75 x M10 at every projection level.

tests: c3_test.py: T1 byte-identical rebuild; T2 2026 Week >= 8 rows rewritten -> identical outputs; T3 k factors unchanged when all 2026 rows are altered; T4 scorer exact (3.6e-15); T5 c3_week.py 8 reproduces the frozen Week 8 file; T6 grading code dry run. All pass.
deviations_policy: Any deviation is listed in the grading report.
